seo.title: About
seo.description: Izakaya WA is Houston's first and only Japanese-owned and operated izakaya, founded by Akira Asano and Hajime Kubokawa. Learn about our story and the meaning of wa.

hero.title: An izakaya in the true sense of the word
hero.intro: Izakaya WA began with a simple idea: bring an honest Japanese neighborhood izakaya to Houston — no theater, just good food, good drink and a warm room.

image.alt: Dining room of a Japanese izakaya at night

story.title: Houston's first and only Japanese-owned izakaya
paragraphs: Izakaya WA was founded by Akira Asano and Hajime Kubokawa, both Japanese, and remains the only izakaya in Houston that is Japanese-owned and operated end to end. That distinction is not a marketing line — it shows up in the details, from the way the fish is broken down to the way a plate is set down.

The name carries the idea behind everything we do. WA (和) is the old Japanese word for Japan itself, and it also means harmony — the balance of flavours, textures and temperatures that makes a table feel complete.

We opened with a menu of small plates, sushi and grilled skewers and a considered list of sake, and we have kept to it. Guests come for a quick lunch or settle in for a long dinner; either way, the room is built for lingering.

values.title: Four things that shape the room

items.title: Japanese-owned & operated
items.copy: Founded and run by Akira Asano and Hajime Kubokawa, both Japanese — the kitchen, the counter and the hospitality are the real thing.

items.title: Cooked to order
items.copy: Sushi is cut when you order it, skewers come off the fire in waves, and plates arrive as they are ready rather than all at once.

items.title: Built for sharing
items.copy: Izakaya dining is a conversation. We keep the plates small and the table generous so everyone can try a little of everything.

items.title: Drinks that matter
items.copy: Sake, shochu, Japanese whisky and beer are chosen to sit alongside the food — ask your server for a pairing.

locations.title: Two rooms, one kitchen
locations.intro: Both locations serve the same menu and share the same standards. Choose the one that is closer to you.
